composite_runtime.rationale: Composite compatibility_legacy paths are retained field_aliases for provider-to-composite joins. They are compatibility aliases over active composite contracts, not a sanctioned path for new schema shapes.
composite_runtime.action: Keep aliases explicit, migrate touched joins toward canonical field-registry ownership, and reject growth in the derived compatibility_legacy group.

entity_effective.rationale: Entity compatibility_legacy paths are retained schema.field_aliases for provider payload normalization. They preserve active provider ingestion while canonical contract fields remain authoritative.
entity_effective.action: Keep aliases explicit, require owner review before adding field_aliases, and migrate touched aliases into canonical contract or semantic registry entries.
